selected_evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 can reach each other directly on any port via node1 routing
selected_evidence.summary: VyOS eth1/eth2 configured and firewall rules committed; ping and arbitrary TCP port (12345) traffic succeeded in both directions between node2 (10.50.10.10) and node3 (10.50.20.10)
tcpdump on node3's LAN interface shows ICMP packets from node2 with unmodified source IP 10.50.10.10, both before and after node restarts, confirming pure routing with no NAT applied

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 5bcff8f9...; reboot issued; connection timed out confirming disruption; new boot_id 7451f01f... on reconnect; VyOS interface config (eth1/eth2 addresses) confirmed persisted post-reboot

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id dfeb3b70...; reboot issued; new boot_id 0099ce2e... on reconnect; enp8s0 static address, routes, and ping to node3 confirmed working post-reboot

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
